name: Two-column story block
purpose: Introduces one programme theme with a headline, a short framing lead and supporting copy beside a single illustrative image.
description: A 2-column row in container-medium: the text column has the H2 pinned to the top and, pinned to the bottom (4rem minimum gap), a large 24px lead (optionally held to 28rem) and an 18px grey paragraph; the right column is a 1:1 dark rounded image card. Stacks at <=991 on /mentoring (stackTab) or <=767 by default, with a 20rem minimum image height. Used four times on /mentoring, each followed by a plain marquee.
